provenance.canonical-source: packages/core/src/progress/ — ONE directory, TWO peer exports. index.tsx: `export * from "./CircularProgress/CircularProgress"; export * from "./LinearProgress/LinearProgress";`. Files read in full: LinearProgress/{LinearProgress.tsx,LinearProgress.css}, CircularProgress/{CircularProgress.tsx,CircularProgress.css}. Behaviour and defaults cross-checked against packages/core/src/__tests__/__e2e__/progress/{LinearProgress.cy.tsx,CircularProgress.cy.tsx}, packages/core/stories/progress/{linear-progress.stories.tsx,circular-progress.stories.tsx,useProgressingValue.tsx} and site/docs/components/progress/{index,usage,examples,accessibility}.mdx. Reused rather than re-derived: docs/foundations/{sizes,spacing,typography,colors,density,layers,motion}.md.
provenance.accent: LinearProgress.css .saltLinearProgress-bar { background: var(--salt-sentiment-accent-background) } and CircularProgress.css .saltCircularProgress-bar { border-color: same } -> next/characteristics/sentiment.css --salt-sentiment-accent-background: var(--salt-palette-accent) -> blue-500 rgb(0,120,207), declared identically under [data-mode="light"] and [data-mode="dark"], hence modeInvariant. Same accent family as badge/card/button/calendar; the data-accent teal alternate is recorded and not modelled (see the accent scope trim in docs/PROGRESS-MATRIX.md).
provenance.root-color: LinearProgress.css .saltLinearProgress { color: var(--salt-content-primary-foreground) } (and CircularProgress.css, twice: on the root and again on the label) -> next/characteristics/content.css --salt-content-primary-foreground: var(--salt-palette-foreground-primary) -> next/palette/foreground.css line 2 --salt-color-black (light) / line 11 --salt-color-white (dark).
provenance.groove-color: LinearProgress.css .saltLinearProgress-track { background: var(--salt-sentiment-neutral-track) } and CircularProgress.css .saltCircularProgress-track { outline-color: same } -> next/characteristics/sentiment.css line 8 --salt-sentiment-neutral-track: var(--salt-palette-alpha-contrast-high) -> next/palette/alpha.css line 14 --salt-color-black-50a (light) / line 46 --salt-color-white-50a (dark) -> foundations/alpha.css rgba(0,0,0,0.5) / rgba(255,255,255,0.5). NOTE the same token also backs Slider's track (packages/core/src/slider/internal/SliderTrack.css line 2) — a shared FOUNDATION token, which is why slider is declared out of scope structurally rather than merged in.
provenance.buffer-fill: LinearProgress.css .saltLinearProgress-buffer { background: var(--salt-container-primary-background) } -> next/characteristics/container.css --salt-container-primary-background: var(--salt-palette-background-primary) -> next/palette/background.css --salt-color-background-snow / -jet -> next/foundations/color.css rgb(255,255,255) / rgb(16,24,32). The buffer is painted in the PAGE'S surface colour, not in a tint of the accent.
provenance.buffer-hairline: LinearProgress.css .saltLinearProgress-buffer { outline: solid var(--salt-size-fixed-100) var(--salt-sentiment-accent-background); outline-offset: calc(var(--salt-size-fixed-100) * -1) } -> foundations/size.css line 47 --salt-size-fixed-100: 1px. FIXED SCALE, DENSITY-INVARIANT BY DESIGN (docs/foundations/sizes.md line 14) — carried as a plain 1px rather than per density, and verified in both directions rather than assumed (lesson 7).
provenance.linear-track-height: LinearProgress.css .saltLinearProgress-barContainer { height: var(--salt-size-bar-strong) } -> foundations/size.css lines 8/18/28/39 = 4/8/12/16 for high/medium/low/touch. Matches docs/foundations/sizes.md line 10.
provenance.linear-groove-height: LinearProgress.css .saltLinearProgress-track { height: var(--salt-size-bar) } -> foundations/size.css lines 3/13/23/34 = 2/4/6/8. Matches docs/foundations/sizes.md line 9. HALF the container: the groove is a thin rail and the bar is a fat overlay.
provenance.linear-groove-offset: LinearProgress.css .saltLinearProgress-track { top: calc((var(--salt-size-bar-strong) - var(--salt-size-bar)) / 2) } = (4−2)/2, (8−4)/2, (12−6)/2, (16−8)/2 = 1/2/3/4. Derived per density from the two slots above rather than snapshotted at medium.
provenance.label-type: LinearProgress.tsx / CircularProgress.tsx render <Text styleAs="h2" className={withBaseName("progressLabel")}> -> next/characteristics/text.css --salt-text-h2-fontFamily: var(--salt-typography-fontFamily-openSans) (line 56, under [data-heading-font="Open Sans"], which is SaltProvider's DEFAULT_HEADING_FONT — asserted in packages/core/src/__tests__/__e2e__/salt-provider/SaltProvider.cy.tsx lines 373/393), --salt-text-h2-fontWeight: var(--salt-typography-fontWeight-semiBold) = 600 (foundations/typography.css line 9), and --salt-text-h2-fontSize/-lineHeight per density block: high 14/18 (line 255), medium 18/24 (line 219), low 24/32 (line 183), touch 32/42 (line 147). provenance.label-gap: LinearProgress.css .saltLinearProgress-progressLabel { padding-left: var(--salt-spacing-100) } -> foundations/spacing.css lines 2/6/10/14 = touch 16, low 12, medium 8, high 4.
provenance.circular-diameter: CircularProgress.css .saltCircularProgress-track / -bar / -bufferBorder / -bufferBackground all use inline-size and block-size calc(var(--salt-size-base) * 3) -> foundations/size.css --salt-size-base 20/28/36/44 (high/medium/low/touch) x3 = 60/84/108/132.
provenance.circular-indicator-thickness: CircularProgress.css .saltCircularProgress-bar { border-width: var(--salt-size-bar-strong) } = 4/8/12/16 — TWICE the track's, exactly as in the linear form.
provenance.circular-track-radius: DERIVED from source geometry, not a token. The track is drawn as an `outline` of width size-bar at `outline-offset: calc(var(--salt-size-bar) * -1.5)`, so the outline occupies 1.5*bar .. 2.5*bar in from the box edge and its ring centre sits at diameter/2 − 2*bar: 30−4=26, 42−8=34, 54−12=42, 66−16=50.
provenance.circular-indicator-radius: DERIVED from source geometry. The bar is a border-box element of the full diameter with `border-width: size-bar-strong`, so its ring centre sits at (diameter − size-bar-strong)/2: (60−4)/2=28, (84−8)/2=38, (108−12)/2=48, (132−16)/2=58. It is therefore OUTSIDE the track's ring, not concentric with it — reproduced rather than collapsed.
provenance.indeterminate: LinearProgress.css .saltLinearProgress-indeterminate.saltLinearProgress-bar { width: 66%; animation: 1.8s ease-in-out infinite salt-indeterminate-progress-bar } and @keyframes salt-indeterminate-progress-bar { 0% translateX(-100%); 60% translateX(155%); 100% translateX(200%) }, with the source comment `/* 155% is slightly more than moving the bar off screen (with width of 66%) */`. Both 1.8s and ease-in-out are HARDCODED LITERALS, not references to Salt's own duration/animation foundations (docs/foundations/motion.md) — the same pattern spinner's 0.9s showed.
provenance.transition: LinearProgress.css declares `transition: transform 0.2s linear` on BOTH .saltLinearProgress-bar/-buffer and .saltLinearProgress-track. The component animates `width` (an inline style) and the track never moves at all, so NEITHER declaration can ever fire. Reproduced as source has it and flagged as a source self-contradiction.
provenance.aria: LinearProgress.tsx: role="progressbar", aria-valuemax={max}, aria-valuemin={min}, aria-valuenow={value === undefined ? undefined : Math.round(value)}. CircularProgress.tsx: identical except aria-valuenow={Math.round(value)} UNCONDITIONALLY, because value defaults to 0 and there is no indeterminate branch. NO aria-valuetext in either. Confirmed by LinearProgress.cy.tsx, which asserts all three attributes on the determinate story and `should("not.have.attr", "aria-valuenow")` on the indeterminate one.

structure.shape.source: packages/core/src/progress/index.tsx exports both; index.mdx: "Two variants are available to accommodate different layouts: CircularProgress and LinearProgress." NO SOURCE DEFAULT — two peer exports; linear is first as a declared registry ordering choice.

structure.fill-mechanism.source: LinearProgress.tsx: const barStyle = { width: isIndeterminate ? undefined : `${progress}%` } applied inline to the bar div

structure.buffer.source: LinearProgress.tsx bufferValue prop -> .saltLinearProgress-buffer; CircularProgress.tsx renders four extra overlay divs when buffer > 0

structure.stop-indicator.note: no end marker of any kind in either Salt CSS file

structure.label.source: LinearProgress.tsx / CircularProgress.tsx: {!hideLabel && <Text styleAs="h2" …>} with hideLabel = false — ON BY DEFAULT

structure.indeterminate-circular.note: CircularProgress.tsx has NO indeterminate branch — value defaults to 0 and aria-valuenow is written unconditionally. Salt's usage.mdx sends the indeterminate case to Spinner, which docs/SPINNER-MATRIX.md already owns.

behavior.role.source: LinearProgress.tsx line 77 and CircularProgress.tsx line 100, both hardcoded role="progressbar"

behavior.value-range.source: both exports take min = 0 and max = 100 and write aria-valuemin={min} / aria-valuemax={max}; the percentage is normalised as ((value - min) / (max - min)) * 100

behavior.determinacy-detection.source: LinearProgress.tsx: const isIndeterminate = value === undefined && bufferValue === undefined. CircularProgress.tsx: no such line — value = 0 default.

behavior.value-now.source: aria-valuenow={value === undefined ? undefined : Math.round(value)} (linear); Math.round(value) unconditionally (circular)

behavior.value-text.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — neither export writes aria-valuetext. Salt puts the human-readable percentage on screen instead (structure.label), which is the exact inverse of shadcn.

behavior.label-formatting.source: isIndeterminate ? "— %" : `${Math.round(progress)} %` — an EM DASH for the unknown case and a SPACE before the percent sign in both

behavior.buffer-visibility.source: linear: {bufferValue && bufferValue > 0 ? <div …/> : null}; circular: {buffer > 0 && …} on the normalised figure. The buffer never enters the label or any ARIA attribute — examples.mdx: "The buffer is a pending value so will not affect the progress label."

prop.shape.source: two peer exports, no default between them

prop.determinacy.note: CAPABILITY LIST, not an ordered default — determinacy is inferred from the value (behavior.determinacy-detection). Indeterminate is reachable on the LINEAR shape only.

prop.hide-label.source: hideLabel = false, and the JSDoc says so in words: "Whether to hide the text label within the progress. Defaults to `false`." Capability list, written default-first.

prop.min.source: min = 0 in both exports, written to aria-valuemin

slot.label.note: Salt formats the string itself and renders it through its own Text component at styleAs="h2" — DECLARED COMPOSITION to a future `text` component.

slot.composes.note: DECLARED COMPOSITION: `text` (the label is a <Text>), and `button` (every story in packages/core/stories/progress drives the value with Start/Stop/Reset Buttons via useProgressingValue.tsx). Neutral placeholders in the harness.

state.rest.value: accent bar over a 50%-alpha groove, bar 2x the groove's thickness
state.rest.source: LinearProgress.css: bar height = barContainer height = size-bar-strong; track height = size-bar

state.complete.note: no terminal state concept — Salt has no data-state and no rule for value === max

state.interaction-states.source: grepped: no :hover, :focus, :focus-visible, :active or disabled selector in LinearProgress.css or CircularProgress.css; no disabled prop in either interface

style.root.min-width.source: LinearProgress.css .saltLinearProgress { min-width: 400px } — a hardcoded pixel literal with no token behind it

style.track.shape.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no border-radius anywhere in LinearProgress.css. A Salt linear progress has square ends.

style.indicator.thickness.source: .saltLinearProgress-bar { top: 0; bottom: 0 } — fills the whole (fat) container

style.indicator.transition.note: DEAD AS DECLARED — the component animates `width`, not `transform`. Reproduced as source has it and flagged.

style.indeterminate.duration.source: animation: 1.8s ease-in-out infinite salt-indeterminate-progress-bar — hardcoded, not a duration token

style.indeterminate.easing.source: same declaration; matches --salt-animation-timing-function in value but is written as a literal

style.buffer.color.source: .saltLinearProgress-buffer { background: var(--salt-container-primary-background); outline: solid var(--salt-size-fixed-100) var(--salt-sentiment-accent-background); outline-offset: calc(var(--salt-size-fixed-100) * -1) }

style.buffer.z-index.source: .saltLinearProgress-buffer { z-index: var(--salt-zIndex-default) } = 1, against the bar's calc(var(--salt-zIndex-default) * 2) = 2

style.circular.track.source: .saltCircularProgress-track { outline-style: solid; outline-width: var(--salt-size-bar); outline-offset: calc(var(--salt-size-bar) * -1.5); outline-color: var(--salt-sentiment-neutral-track) }

style.circular.indicator.source: .saltCircularProgress-bar { border-color: var(--salt-sentiment-accent-background); border-style: solid; border-width: var(--salt-size-bar-strong) }
